# pushsecurity_app (Data Source)

Looks up a single app by type.

Fails if the type matches no app, so a mistyped app type is caught during plan rather than narrowing a control to nothing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A single app, by type. Fails during plan if no such app exists in the tenant.
data "pushsecurity_app" "workspace" {
  type = "GOOGLE_WORKSPACE"
}

output "workspace_categories" {
  value = data.pushsecurity_app.workspace.category_names
}

output "workspace_sensitivity" {
  value = data.pushsecurity_app.workspace.sensitivity_level
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) The app's type, for example `GOOGLE_WORKSPACE`. Must match exactly one app in the tenant.

### Read-Only

- `approval_status` (String) The app's approval status, as used by the `approval_statuses` criterion. Empty when the app has not been reviewed.
- `category_codes` (Set of String) The app's category codes, as used by the `app_categories` criterion. Strings, because that is what the criterion matches on.
- `category_names` (Set of String) The human-readable names of the app's categories.
- `friendly_name` (String) The app's display name.
- `id` (String) The app's identifier.
- `labels` (Set of String) The labels applied to the app, as used by the `app_labels` criterion.
- `sensitivity_level` (String) The app's sensitivity level, as used by the `sensitivity_levels` criterion. Empty when it has not been set.
- `website` (String) The app's website.
